title: Iodinated disinfection byproduct formation from iohexol in sunlit and chlorinated urban wastewaters
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00709G, Paper
Open Access

Reagan Patton Witt, Marcelo I. Guzman
Iodinated disinfection by-products (I-DBPs) are of growing concern due to their elevated toxicity compared to their chlorinated counterparts, with links to adverse health effects such as bladder cancer and miscarriages.
